Folders in the sidebar now sort by how much you use them, and you can pin the ones you want at the top. On macOS, ⌘K no longer makes the app flicker endlessly.

**Folders, sorted by use and pin-able** (#695)

- Personal folders show pinned ones first, then the most-used. Org folders work the same way. The order is a snapshot, so a row never jumps under the cursor when you click it.
- Pin or unpin a folder from the row's hover strip, or from its context menu.
- The Light / Dark / System switch no longer takes a full row at the foot of the sidebar. It now floats over the bottom-left corner.

**⌘K no longer makes the app flicker on macOS** (#695)

- Opening the command palette with ⌘K could make the released app flicker without stopping. That loop is fixed.
